composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. creative_direction: Shape a fish from broad golden satin with a turquoise reverse, capturing a tight inward turn. Tuck the tail beneath its small head and keep the eye a quiet dark stitch. Show folds tightening on the inside curve and relaxing outside. Soft overhead light traces the fabric sheen against deep slate, leaving the action compact and elegant. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
